quarterly_data.quarter: Doosan Enerbility press release: Doosan Enerbility Signs Contract with TerraPower to (08-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customer TerraPower: Doosan Enerbility signed a contract to manufacture key equipment for TerraPower's Natrium reactor - reactor guard vessels, reactor support structures and reactor internal structures - for the First-of-a-Kind (FOAK) unit in Kemmerer, Wyoming, a 345 MW sodium-cooled fast reactor (output can rise to 500 MW with molten salt energy storage) that began construction in spring 2026 after an NRC construction permit. The order follows a manufacturability review contract signed in December 2024. Nuclear Business Group CEO Jongdoo Kim: the company will continue to strengthen its SMR manufacturing capabilities and expand its role as a global supplier.
quarterly_data.figure: contract value not disclosed; FOAK unit 345 MW (up to 500 MW with storage)
